metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Sampled mean off-diagonal cosine of the backbone tied item table, mapped to [0,1]. Higher means directional alignment, not definitive collapse or recommendation diversity. Null when fewer than two embeddings are sampled.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Counts valid loader positions with margin below eps or zero. Category lists remain empty because item category metadata is unavailable.
